verses.html: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;
verses.text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;
verses.title: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
verses.titleHtml: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.

verses.html: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;
verses.text: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;

verses.html: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.
verses.text: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.

verses.html: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.
verses.text: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.

verses.html: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.
verses.text: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.

verses.html: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.
verses.text: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.

verses.html: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.
verses.text: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.

verses.html: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.
verses.text: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.

verses.html: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.
verses.text: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.
